title: SOC2 daily scratchpad - Michael Shah
content:
Quick notes / mental notebook (SOC2 prep)

2024-11-13 — Morning
- Daily focus: finish vendor A evidence request + confirm encryption KMS screenshots for Dedicated onboarding.
- Blockers: vendor A support ticket pending (vendor-support@vendorA.com). Need ETA.

Top priorities (today)
1) Vendor A - encryption & access controls
- Collect SAML config screenshots from infra (ticket: SEC-1123). Owner: Alex R.
- Ask Vendor A for SOC2 attestation or bridge letter. TODO: draft email (use Priya's template).
- If no attestation in 72h, escalate to procurement.
2) Evidence pack: key management (KMS)
- Grab KMS rotation policy screenshot from cloud-console (region-us-east-1). Owner: me.
- Export KMS key policy diff from last quarter (link to Confluence page above).
- Note: check HSM integration doc (private-deployments repo) for on-prem customers.
3) Access reviews (quarterly)
- Remind managers in slack #security-compliance to complete access review by 11/20.
- Draft reminder message: "Please complete app access reviews by EOD 11/20 — link to spreadsheet".

Evidence checklist (working)
- [ ] KMS key policy screenshots (created_at+rotation) — expect to complete today
- [x] MFA enforcement policy doc (policy v1.2) — pulled from Confluence 11/07
- [ ] Okta SAML assertion logs (last 90 days) — request from ID team (owner: Samira)
- [ ] Service account inventory export (CSV) — need from infra, depends on PR from platform-eng

Vendor review notes
- Vendor A (data pipeline): status = waiting on attestation. Risks: stores logs for 30 days, not encrypted at rest by default (we have contract clause). Mitigation: require encryption-at-rest, add to contract amendment.
- Vendor B (monitoring): current SOC2 Type II on file (procurement portal). Add to vendor register and mark as reviewed.

Policy TODOs
- Update Incident Response runbook with phone tree + escalation matrix — draft version exists in Confluence but missing oncall numbers. Owner: Michael. Deadline: 11/22.
- Update third-party risk checklist to include encryption-by-default column. Owner: Procurement. Add to template used for vendor onboarding.

Meeting notes (11/12 retrospective)
- With Priya, Samira: agreed to centralize evidence storage under /sec-evidence/monthly/<vendor>. Use retention policy 7 years for audit trail.
- Action: Samira to create folder structure and share ACLs with audit@redwood.ai.

Short-term reminders
- Email draft: vendor A follow-up (use subject: "SOC2 attestation request - Redwood") — send after 2pm PT.
- Run script to pull KMS rotation history: scripts/sec/export_kms_history.sh — check with infra for AWS credentials.

Notes to self
- Keep evidence file names consistent: <vendor>_<artifact>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf
- When oncall, capture timeline in incident runbook ASAP (even if incomplete).

Links / references
- Controls mapping: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Controls+Mapping+2024
- Vendor register (GSheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VendorRegister
- Jira ticket for service account inventory: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-1201

End-of-day quick log (to fill)
- Items completed: 
- Blockers opened: 
- Hand-off for tomorrow:

-- Michael
